description: This file defines a data structure for shared content payloads and contains functions to construct URLs and message strings for sharing content via a custom URL scheme, including cleaning and limiting message length.

classes.name: SharedContentPayload
classes.description: A data structure representing shared content with optional title, URL, and text.

methods.name: buildURL
methods.description: Constructs a custom URL with a message query parameter built from the payload and optional instruction.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Generates a formatted message string from the payload and instruction, applying cleaning and length limiting.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newlines; returns nil if resulting string is empty.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Restricts the message string to a maximum number of characters.
